name: Modi Naturals Ltd
title: Modi Naturals Ltd - 519003 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ethanol Phase 2 took capacity to 282 KLPD late in FY26 with FY27 ethanol revenue guided ~INR950 crores at only ~50% utilisation of the expansion; management dismisses overcapacity risk while a 10% private OMC share limits near-term volume visibility.

utilisation.quote: we have factored in only about 50% capacity utilization of the expansion

capex.peers_comment: Management acknowledged media reports of industry overcapacity and underutilisation but said the company is well poised.
capex.quote: We don't have any large capex envisaged for this financial year.

triggers.label: Ethanol expansion at 50% utilisation assumed
triggers.quote: we have factored in only about 50% capacity utilization of the expansion

triggers.label: Overcapacity risk acknowledged
triggers.quote: risk, as has been highlighted in media over the last few months, is that of overcapacity and underutilization

triggers.label: FY27 ethanol revenue ~INR950 crores
triggers.quote: the top line guidance of an average of INR950 crores is also very conservative in nature

triggers.label: Ethanol EBITDA margin 12-15% sustainable
triggers.quote: we will achieve between 12% to 15% EBITDA in this division on a sustainable basis

guidance.quote: the top line guidance of an average of INR950 crores is also very conservative in nature
we will achieve between 12% to 15% EBITDA in this division on a sustainable basis
our consolidated revenue will cross INR1,100 crores
I don't see any reason why this segment for us should not get to INR500 crores in the medium term

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue, EBITDA and PAT guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: Successfully achieved FY26 guidance across revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, despite delayed ramp-up of expanded ethanol capacities.

evasions.topic: Export policy and licence readiness for ethanol
evasions.quote: I wouldn't be able to comment on that. That would be speculation.
We've evaluated a few opportunities in the food sector, but nothing that we have firmed up yet.

red_flags.label: Auditor resignation and change
red_flags.quote: this was always planned. I think this is more of a succession

red_flags.label: Ethanol Q4 margin inflated by one-off insurance claim
red_flags.quote: in the last quarter, we had an exceptional item which actually increased our EBITDA margin to 18.8%
